result:
Only our two files exist, and the run above already covered both — all 76 tests passed.

Created two self-contained JUnit 5 test classes:

- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/DurationUtilsAgentTest.java` — covers `accept`, `get`/`getMillis`/`getSeconds` (missing/empty/null key defaults), `getNanosOfMilli`/deprecated `getNanosOfMiili`, `isPositive` (positive/zero/negative/null), `of(consumer/runnable)`, `since`, `toChronoUnit` (all enum values + null), `toDuration`, `toMillisInt` (normal, int boundaries, overflow in both directions, null), `zeroIfNull`, and the deprecated constructor.
- `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/StopWatchAgentTest.java` — covers state transitions and their guard exceptions (start/stop/suspend/resume/split/unsplit in illegal states), split/unsplit semantics (labels, unmodifiable split list, unsplit continuing from original start), timing getters (`getTime`, `getDuration`, `getStartInstant`/`getStopInstant` and their deprecated counterparts), the `run`/`runT`/`get`/`getT` delegation helpers (including exception propagation and post-call suspended state), and the `Split` inner class.

Both ran via `./_tools/test.sh` with 76/76 tests passing.
